name: Snow
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.459

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: wind-sculpted fresh snow built here: sastrugi as wind-aligned terraced ridges with undercut risers over low drift swells (synthesised height, 3 m period), fine crust normal from ambientCG Snow008A, glazed wind-packed crests and sparse crystal glints in roughness. No tracks. Wind runs along U
known_weaknesses: sastrugi are synthesised, fine and even in size (no large drifts); wind direction is fixed along U; albedo is capped at 240 so subsurface and sparkle bloom must come from the Unreal material; two review rounds on this version
